name: After § 68
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 68a. Recalls the provisional measures ordered by the International Court of Justice regarding the application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide in the Gaza Strip (*South Africa *v* Israel*); stresses the need for international law to be upheld and respected; calls on the European Council and the Commission to ensure that the EU is in no way complicit in violations of international law, including under the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide;
